objective: Bring Neeka's Report to Helgrum the Swift in Stonard.

description: I wrote a fresh report for Helgrum in Stonard.  Bring it to him.
And if you consider yourself an outrunner, then don't lose your way.  Or fall to an enemy.
progress: You returned. You have a report?
completion: Thank you, <name>. From Neeka's report, I see the Alliance is not without its own problems. And we may find that some enemies are shared between us.
